title: Scheduled batch services wait for the host heavy-job gate
body:
Source: t-qj1tpbe evidence (host sampler 2026-11-19): mise-en-plesk's scheduled audit scan (`run-scheduled-scan.sh` -> `node mise-plesk-audit.js scan ...`) runs from the systemd user unit mise-en-plesk.service, which no agent hook reaches.
Outcome: the unit's scan waits for the host heavy-job gate (a drop-in wrapping ExecStart with `heavy-gate run --`, or the project's own script calling it), decided against krn-only-scope and host-capacity-grant; other systemd user units that run batch work on this host are listed with a verdict each.
Proof: during a scheduled scan run, heavy-gate status lists the scan as a holder or waiting job.
